In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Death/Legends|death]] [[Cult of M'dweshuu]] launched a string of '''homicidal murders''' along the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] of the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]] region. During the attacks, the cult killed at least twenty&ndash;seven beings, and the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] began investigating the murders. The [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] later reported on the murders.
